messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High GPU queue growth detected in prod-gpu-pool. Autoscaler reports lack of HPA custom metric updates for 7m, queue length trending up. Severity: P2 — paging oncall.
leah.s: acked. I'm on it. what's current queue size and throttling? any customer-facing errors showing 429s?
samir.k: seeing a steady increase — queue size ~420 -> 930 over 10m on the inference queue. Some requests are hitting throttling; we have a handful of 429s surfaced in the logs. Customer support reported degraded latencies for a few teams.
leah.s: thanks. can you check prometheus-adapter and metrics-server? HPA not scaling if custom metrics are stale.
samir.k: pulling logs now. `kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/prometheus-adapter --tail=100` shows repeated timeouts to Prometheus: "context deadline exceeded" and large scrape backlog. Adapter metrics show last successful sync 11m ago.
ryan.t: from infra side: prometheus pod CPU is at 95% and TSDB compaction is spiking I/O. Looks like scrape backlog from high-cardinality metrics. Could be recent model rollout increasing label cardinality.
marta.p: paging SRE to check for recent model rollout that added extra labels. @ryan.t which deployment changed recently?
ryan.t: `inference-worker-v4` had an image push ~20m ago, yes. It added a per-tenant label for requests; that could blow up scraped series.
leah.s: ok immediate plan: 1) stop new scrapes for the high-cardinality endpoint (temporary relabel), 2) restart/scale prometheus adapter and metrics-server to clear backlog, 3) temporarily increase GPU pool via manual scaling and adjust HPA minReplicas to avoid further queuing. Assigning tasks.
samir.k: taking (2) — restarting prometheus-adapter and metrics-server now. Running: `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-adapter` and `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deploy/metrics-server`.
samir.k: adapter restarted, logs show reconnected, initial sync success at 2912345686. metrics-server restarted as well.
leah.s: I'm (1) — applying relabel rule to drop tenant label for inference-worker metrics to cut series explosion. Patch applied in prom config and reloading Prometheus: `kubectl -n monitoring exec deploy/prometheus -- prometheus --reload`.
ryan.t: reload accepted. Prom scrape series dropped ~78% on the inference metrics target. TSDB I/O leveling off.
leah.s: (3) manual scaling: bumping GPU pool nodes and adjusting HPA min. `kubectl -n infra scale deployment/gpu-nodepool --replicas=6` and `kubectl -n workloads patch hpa/inference-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}' --type=merge` — executing.
oncall-ops-bot: Automated action: triggered cloud provider scale-up request for gpu-nodepool -> 6 nodes. ETA ~3m for nodes to register.
samir.k: HPA now seeing metrics again thanks to adapter restart and relabel; current CPU/custom metrics updated. But because ASG already queued scale decisions, adding nodes helps.
leah.s: also temporarily route lower-priority traffic to a degraded path: updating router rule to send non-critical tenants to small-model fallback: `routing apply --policy fallback-smallmodel`.
marta.p: customer impact note for SRE/CS: some customers experienced elevated latency and 429s between 2912345600 - 2912345680. Please prepare message: brief cause (metrics ingestion spike -> delayed autoscaling), mitigation (relabeling, adapter restart, manual scale), and ETA for monitoring.
ryan.t: confirming nodes came up and taints cleared. New GPU nodes registered at 2912345689.
samir.k: observed queue drain starting ~2912345690. Throttles dropping.
leah.s: handing off to next oncall @marta.p for investigation/clean-up and follow-ups: tasks for postmortem — 1) find exact change in inference-worker that added label cardinality, 2) add a safety relabel rule in Prometheus to prevent tenant label blow-ups, 3) add adapter liveness/sync alert, 4) document scaledown plan for GPU pool.
marta.p: acked. taking over. summary for handoff: cause = sudden increase in metric cardinality from inference-worker rollout causing Prometheus scrape backlog -> prometheus-adapter sync stalled -> HPA custom metrics stale -> autoscaler didn't trigger -> queue buildup -> GPU pool exhausted & throttling. Mitigations performed: relabel to drop tenant label, restart prometheus-adapter & metrics-server, manual scale-up of GPU pool, router fallback to small model. Current status: queue draining, no new 429 spikes in last 2m. ETA for full recovery = 15–25m as backfill completes.
leah.s: good work team. please file incident page and severity review. incident-bot: create incident page with severity P2 and link to postmortem checklist.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2912345678. Assigned owners: marta.p (lead), samir.k (metrics), ryan.t (infra). Please update the incident page with timeline and customer impact.
marta.p: I'll coordinate the postmortem and notify product/support for customer comms. Leaving this thread; follow-ups will be on INC-2026-2912345678.
leah.s: thanks all. :thumbsup:
